content:
A Top Performer Resigned 💔 Because of ONE Sentence From His Manager.

He was one of the team's best employees.
After a small mistake, his manager said:

Maybe you're not good enough for this job.
He didn't argue.

Two weeks later, he resigned.
The manager was shocked.

Sometimes, one sentence doesn't make an employee leave.
It confirms what they've been feeling for months.

Choose your words carefully.

Pls share your views 🙏 

Follow Shashi Jha for HR and Career Insights 🙏
comment: The impact often starts before the resignation. High performers usually leave after repeated signals that their effort is undervalued, so managers need feedback systems that separate correcting mistakes from questioning someone's capability.
